title.narrative: De Dag van de Waardeketen een dag vol ontmoeting, dialoog en inspiratie over eerlijkere en duurzamere handelsketens.

description.narrative:
Audience: Students (main audience given the venue), policymakers (ministries), NGOs, (social) entrepreneurs, politicians
Objective: To provide new mind-stretching insights and to inspire.
The participants will leave feeling inspired with new insights as to how to make value chains perform better for everyone. They will get an honest and in-depth overview of how international value chains ‘work’, who controls them and, consequently, where the opportunities lie to make these supply chains more fair and sustainable. Value chains are a complex topic. At the conference we will show the complexity, not hide it. We will discuss the topic from different angles, including the more critical voices that challenge assumptions in the supply chain or proposed improvements.
So there will be some ‘uncomfortness’ during the day that will make people think and reflect on a deeper level. The overall message will be that the prosperity and well-being of the Netherlands/Europe and that of supplier countries are deeply interconnected. Everyone in the chain has a role to play. From producers, policymakers and entrepreneurs to knowledge institutes, NGOs and students on both sides of the value chain.
